geology_info.alteration: Propylitization And Argillization Of Host Rocks Are Intense.  Adularia Replacement Of K-Feldspars And Plagioclase Is Associated With Ore.  Plagioclase And Groundmass Are Replaced With Quartz And Sericite.   Within Propylitically Altered Rock, Biotite Is Partially Or Wholly Altered To Chlorite.  Groundmass Is Altered To Chlorite +/- Clay +/- Carbonate+/- Epidote.  Plagioclase Phenocrysts Are Altered To Sericite (Illite) As Small Points, Clots, And Veinlets Along Cleavage Planes.  Argillically Altered Rock Contains No Unaltered Biotite Or Plagioclase, Both Phases Being Altered To Clay (Illite, Montmorillonite, Kaolinite) And Sericite.  Groundmass Is Entirely Composed Of Fine-Grained Clays And Sericite.  Quartz-Adularia Silicification Is Widespread Along The Veins. Degree Of Silicification, Sericite + Argillic Alteration Increases With (Higher) Elevation. Fine-Grained Secondary Quartz Has Replaced Original Plagioclase Feldspars, Occurs As Clots In The Groundmass, And As Hairline Veinlets That Lace The Rock.
